description: This file implements the 'git bugreport' command, which generates bug report documents including system info, hooks, diagnostics, and a user-supplied template. It handles command-line options, gathers environment and system data, creates report files, and optionally invokes an editor.

methods.name: void get_system_info(struct strbuf * sys_info)
methods.description: Gathers system environment information such as git version, uname info, compiler info, libc info, and shell environment and appends these details to the provided string buffer.

methods.name: void get_populated_hooks(struct strbuf * hook_info,int nongit)
methods.description: Checks if hooks exist in the repository and appends their names to the provided string buffer, unless not in a git repository.

methods.name: int get_bug_template(struct strbuf * template)
methods.description: Fills the provided string buffer with a predefined bug report template message.

methods.name: void get_header(struct strbuf * buf,const char * title)
methods.description: Adds a header line with a title enclosed in brackets to the provided string buffer.

methods.name: int cmd_bugreport(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function that processes command-line arguments, creates report files with system info and hooks, optionally generates diagnostics, and opens the report in an editor.

ctags.name: cmd_bugreport
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
